item.title: SHAFT 0.88.0
item.description:
Artifacts: interactive pages an instance makes and keeps up to date (#82, template #83).

  • An instance writes notes/artifacts/<slug>/ (index.html, optional data.json as window.SHAFT_DATA, .js/.css beside it); a scheduled plugin job can keep data.json current without a cycle (publishes).
  • Web UI: instance → Artifacts, the page in a sandboxed frame (opaque origin, nothing loaded from the network), reloaded only when its version moves; problems listed above it.
  • Apps (Mac, iPhone, iPad): side panel → Artifacts, a web view with no storage that blocks every load; links open in the browser after confirmation.
  • Template: skills/making-artifacts.md teaches instances the format.
